quality_constraint: per-session request pass rate q_i(pi) >= q_i(BBBBB)
information_access: ex-post: uses each session's realized outcomes of every executed policy; not deployable; within executed-path set only (no path splicing)
T_ref: mean latency of BBBBB on the same eval condition (post-hoc normalization; v3 policies will use a dev-fixed T_ref)
crossfit: scenario-informed diagnostic baseline: per scenario 5/5 session split, select one of six schedules on half, evaluate on the other half; 200 splits (not independent samples)
bootstrap: scenario-stratified session bootstrap, 2000; cross-fit re-run inside each resample
